Complete [[Venta Cemetery]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Take [[Koss]] and escort the [[Sunspear Evacuee|Sunspear evacuees]] from the [[Venta Cemetery (outpost)|Venta Cemetery]] to the boat at [[Dajkah Inlet (outpost)|Dajkah Inlet]].
* *[[Bonus|BONUS]]* Neutralize all 12 [[Guard Post|guard posts]].
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 300 [[Sunspear Promotion Points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per the [[Venta Cemetery#Walkthrough|Venta Cemetery]] mission.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;[[Zaishen Mission]]
:''"The [[Order of the Sunspears|Sunspear forces]] stranded in [[Kourna]] need strengthening to get past the garrison in the Venta Cemetery. A ship awaits to take them home to [[Istan]]. Interested parties should contact Koss and meet the Sunspears at the Venta Cemetery."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = The battle rages on! All able-bodied heroes should hasten to defend those bravely protecting [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]]. }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''
